accepted.reason: Owner-approved, time-boxed acceptance of residual risk (not a remediation): node-forge <= 1.4.0 (RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification accepts extra nested DigestAlgorithm elements, high, CVSS 7.5) has no patched release; npm latest is 1.4.0 and the advisory lists no first patched version. Verified at 65d968f7: node-forge@1.4.0 enters the mobile graph only via expo-updates -> @expo/code-signing-certificates and expo -> @expo/cli. Neither mobile/app.json nor mobile/app.config.js defines updates.codeSigningCertificate, and no app source imports node-forge, so exposure is build/CLI tooling only. Re-review, or bump if a patched release exists, before 2026-11-01; the gate fails after that date.

Owner-approved, time-boxed acceptance of residual risk (not a remediation): braces <= 3.0.3 (stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested patterns, high, CVSS 7.5, published 2026-09-18) has no patched release; the advisory lists no first patched version and npm latest is 3.0.3. Verified at 55a5a32a with npm --prefix mobile ls --package-lock-only --all: braces@3.0.3 is reached only through micromatch@4.0.8, by two kinds of path. Dev/test path: the declared devDependency jest@29.7.0 -> @jest/core@29.7.0 -> micromatch@4.0.8 -> braces@3.0.3; mobile/package.json invokes Jest only through its test script. Build-tool path, independently verified and present with --omit=dev, so not a Jest-only path: the production dependency expo@54.0.35 -> @expo/metro@54.2.0 -> metro-file-map@0.83.3 -> micromatch@4.0.8 -> braces@3.0.3, which is Expo Metro bundler tooling (the lockfile also reaches Metro and Jest packages through react-native -> @react-native/community-cli-plugin -> metro and react-native -> babel-jest). The only lockfile dependents of micromatch are Jest packages and metro-file-map, and the root package has an empty dependency graph. No mobile application source imports braces, micromatch, Jest, or Metro. Shipping uses EAS build profiles (mobile/eas.json) and Expo configuration (mobile/app.json, mobile/app.config.js); a shipped app artifact has not been exhaustively inspected, so these are dependency-graph, configuration, and source-import facts only. Re-review, or bump if a patched release exists, before 2026-11-01; the gate fails after that date.
